For fixed \(P\),
\[
|PM|-|PN|\le (|P C_M|+2)-(|P C_N|-2)=|P C_M|-|P C_N|+4.
\]
The circle centers are \(C_M=(-4,0)\), \(C_N=(4,0)\), the foci of the hyperbola. For \(P\) on the right branch,
\[
|P C_M|-|P C_N|=2a=2.
\]
Therefore,
\[
|PM|-|PN|\le 2+4=6.
\]
This is attainable, e.g. \(P=(1,0)\), \(M=(-6,0)\), \(N=(2,0)\).

\[
\boxed{6}
\]
